body:
I began my day as usual, coffee and no breakfast. I decided to pop 3 50mg vyvanse pills at school at approximately 7:20.
7:20AM T+ 0:00 Pills taken, optimistic and slightly sleepy, I go to my first period class. I notice I'm much warmer than usual, probably not due to the Vyvanse, but I thought it was noteable
7:55AM T+ 0:35 Starting to feel initial effects of Vyvanse. Many people believe this drug takes 1-2 hours to kick in but for me it feels more like about half an hour. Initial effects include higher interest in class and helping other. Communicating and talking about ANYTHING is far more enjoyable
~8:20AM T+ 1:00 Full effects of Vyvanse being felt : Increased heart rate, Slight but noticeable euphoria, and increased interest in everything, the usual. One thing I notice is that Vyvanse greatly increases vasoconstriction (tightening of blood vessels) with higher doses (100mg+) This is why it's very important to stay as hydrated as possible and HAVE FOOD IN MY STOMACH.
8:20AM - 3:15PM (The rest of the school day) Vyvanse makes my day go by very fast, and it seems over very quickly. Unfortunately, I had to go to work today, and the effects of Vyvanse's apparently smoother comedown were hitting me rather hard. It's very difficult to converse with others in the 'comedown' state of mind. Lethargy takes the place of euphoria. Although I have experienced Adderall, Focalin, Ritalin, and Dexedrine comedowns, I would have to say Vyvanse is probably actually the smoothest, although it is still not fun.
The key to enjoying Vyvanse is to stay hydrated and moderate my dosage.
